data.name: WonderLang English
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to WonderLang, where mastering English transforms into an engaging RPG journey. Immerse yourself in captivating quests, interactive dialogues, and fun puzzles designed to make language learning seamless and enjoyable.

WonderLang weaves language into the core of its adventure and compelling narrative. Get immersed in Wonderlang, as you: Explore, Fight, Converse and Investigate using your target language.

More affordable, more engaging, and way more fun than any subscription-based language learning app!

WonderLang is designed for beginner language learners, allowing you to dive into the game without any prior knowledge of the language. While the game doesn't aim to fully replace traditional language courses, it provides an immersive and enjoyable way to practice a new language gradually.

                                                               

British English available now, American English will be added for free mid-April 2026

Key Features

  • Immersive English Learning

    • Learn practical English through every conversation, quest, and puzzle.

    • More than 40 hours of combined learning and gameplay.

    • 3 Modes to adapt the difficulty for beginners, A1 and A2 level learners.

                                                               

  • Engaging Storyline

    • Follow the journey of a young hero who must learn English to lift a magical curse from their brother.

    • Explore vibrant villages, uncover secrets, and build friendships interracting with over 60 unique NPCs.

  • Learning as a Gameplay Mechanic

    • Solve puzzles, and complete quests by forming sentences and understanding dialogues.

    • Practice building sentences and pronunciation thanks to speech recognition challenges (On Windows only for the moment).

    • Utilize in-game tools like a dictionary and contextual help to aid your learning.

                                                             

  • Spaced Repetition Combat Challenges

    • Engage in language-based combat to reinforce language retention.

    • Combat challenges are designed using the spaced repetition principle

  • Real-World Context Practice

    • Apply your English skills in everyday scenarios such as buying groceries or making an appointment at the doctor.

    • Experience practical vocabulary and grammar in real-world contexts to enhance your language proficiency.

                                                       

  • Customizable Learning Experience

    • Customize your learning journey with various difficulty settings to make the experience more or less challenging based on your preference.

    • Set daily goals and earn rewards for reaching them, helping you build a consistent learning routine.

  • Rich Interactive World

    • Explore exotic locations, each introducing specific English vocabulary and grammar rules.

    • Participate in mini-games like crosswords, memory games, and charades to diversify your learning experience.

      WonderLang can be played with a mouse and keyboard, mouse only, or keyboard only.

      It also plays great on the Steam Deck with an official control layout.

      Other languages available to learn (separate versions of WonderLang): French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean.

data.short_description: Learn English through immersive quests, interactive dialogues, and spaced repetition combat challenges. Help a young hero lift a magical curse by mastering English. Customize your learning experience and explore a vibrant world filled with unique characters. Start your journey in English today!
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft Windows® 8.1/10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS 11.00 or better
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
